title: How to add smart pathing for the player

posts.author: Live2Kill
posts.body: Looking for a way to make the player have some sort of smart pathing that will auto walk around tiles you cant walk on.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Live2Kill said:
How would I use these script calls? Like on an event? Im not sure I understand.
Click to expand...
Yes, you would apply the movement to the player using an event command.
$gameTemp.setDestination(4, 5)
can be used in a
Script
command. It should mimic the player clicking on map tile (4, 5), which makes the player (try to) path to that tile. As noted, normal movement input can interrupt this.
The other two are for use in a move route, e.g. via the
Set Movement Route
command. A move route targets a character, which can be the player. One of the move route commands is labelled Script: that's where you would put the script call.
this.moveStraight(this.findDirectionTo(4, 5))
As noted, this script call moves the character 1 step on a path to the specified tile: (4, 5) in this case. But you probably want the next one instead...
var x = 4, y = 5; var d = this.findDirectionTo(x, y); if (!d || !this.canPass(this.x, this.y, d)) { this.forceMoveRoute({ list: [{ code: 0 }] }); this.setMovementSuccess(true); this._moveRouteIndex--; } else this.moveStraight(d);
As noted, this script call is designed to be used as the only command in a repeating move route. It will repeatedly move the character 1 step on the path until they are at the destination or the path is blocked. Then the move route will end.
These examples all used fixed coordinates: X = 4, Y = 5. If the destination moves around, then you'll need to replace those fixed numbers with something else. E.g. path to event ID 8:
var x = $gameMap.event(8).x, y = $gameMap.event(8).y; var d = this.findDirectionTo(x, y); if (!d || !this.canPass(this.x, this.y, d) { this.forceMoveRoute({ list: [{ code: 0 }] }); this.setMovementSuccess(true); this._moveRouteIndex--; } else this.moveStraight(d);
